profile.headline: Software Engineer, UI Focused Full Stack Developer, Experienced SQL Developer, Manager
profile.summary:
●  A full stack lead developer and manager involved in every phase of development with an eye toward building effective frontend UI.  
●  A creative coder with extensive experience building back office applications to help solve business problems that increase accuracy, productivity, and efficiency.  
●  Started programing using C, transitioned to extensively building full featured UI in Visual Basic 6, to building full stack web applications using Java and JavaScript with various frameworks. 
●  Built a full web stack framework that supports over twenty applications used in reporting, querying, scheduling, monitoring and workflow.  
●  Strong, diverse, and flexible programming skills. Interested in taking a leading role in building end-user focused web applications and solve complex and interesting problems along the way.


Technical Skills
●Language: Java, JavaScript, SQL, VB6, Perl, Pascal, FORTRAN, C, Groovy 
●Database: MySQL, SQL Server, Vertica, Oracle, Sybase 
●Technology: Angular 6/7, NodeJS, Spring Boot, Sencha ExtJS, Docker, ReactJS, GWT, GIT

positions.title: Lead Angular Developer
positions.description: Lead UI developer updating and implementing new requirements into existing ecosystem.  Extensively work with the Product Owners/ UX designers to help with new UI and workflow.  As well as doing rapid prototype/poc for up coming work.  Mentoring and leading developers in front-end development using TDD/Dojo methodology.  I hold training sessions in Angular IO development and Jasmine Unit testing.  Currently, part of the discovery team to move on premises to AWS cloud.  Taking lead in updating our simple display UI to be a real SPA Web App.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Lead developer building SPA web application using Agile methodology.  Responsible for implementing coding standards and patterns.  Built a seed application using Angular6/ Node.js microservices/ PostgreSQL/Docker.  Leading and mentoring junior developers.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (Shared Services)
positions.description:
A full life-cycle and full stack developer in the finance organization responsible for building web applications, reporting, monitoring, and automation tools to support the billing and reporting process.
• Designed and built a complex single page web application, Billing Workflow, to facilitate monthly invoice generation by collecting and aggregating both first and third-party data to calculate billable amounts within SOX controlled environment.
     -     Back-end server extracts, transforms and loads data daily, calculates invoices, assigns status and  
        analyst, implements various billing workflows, keeps robust audit logs and REST/JSON API.  
     -     Frontend allowed Billing Analyst (BA) to resolve issue, align data, change status, request approval, 
       archive supporting documents and save notes.
•	Developed Billing Portal for Account Managers (AM) to approve or reject billing numbers and have full visibility into their invoices.  Applications allowed AM to directly interact with (BA) via notes.  The portal consumed and interacted with the Billing Workflow tool.
•	Implemented Reporting Workflow Framework to serve billing invoice data used for workflow management for both billing and account management and sales commission statement.
•	Internationalized tools to support fourteen different currency.
•	Automated DoubleClick data collections using API to build over two thousand different reports and collect over two million rows of data per day.  Improved accuracy, reliability and saved time.
•	Built a front-end admin UI for DoubleClick data.  User can create new reports and monitor processes. 
•	Project managed, QA, maintained all the tools.  Supported users with issues and continually added new functionality and features based on stakeholders’ requests.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer  (Ad Solutions)
positions.description:
Managed five developers (3 in India), responsible for building and maintaining over twenty various applications that supported the Ad Operations, Inventory group, and shared services.  Developed a full stack web framework using Java, Tomcat, Spring, MyBatis, Apache, JavaScript, and Sencha ExtJS.
•	Built Reporting Framework software stack which allows user to build dynamic custom query, aggregate, export, save and share reports.  Framework allows developers to easily build a new internal interactive report within days. Currently AOL/Oath have over ten different internal reports using the framework. 
•	Created inventory request tool, involving multiple forms, complex UI elements and workflow process.  The tool allowed site owners to request new inventory and inventory specialists to build out specification and get approval.  This tool replaced emails, phone calls and Excel template.
•	Developed approval tools for AM to see their invoices and approve or reject the billing amounts.  Tool was built upon the Reporting Framework with expanded functionality.
•	Designed Roadblock and Sponsorship tool using Google Web Toolkit.  The tool allowed AM’s to reserve high-priced inventory based on special rules generated by inventory specialists.
•	Automated tedious process to manually transfer IO data from one system to another by using iMacros, Java.  Which reduced errors and reduced the turnaround time to minutes rather than hours.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Ad System Group)
positions.description:
Software developer responsible for building full feature frontend UI and back-end servers.  Extensively built tools using Agile and SDLC development process.
•	Developed inventory availability system server which processed millions of data using J2EE, MyBatis, JAX-WS and Sybase
•	Built Popup Rule IDE using Java Swing UI and Axis SOAP messaging to communicate with Popup server farm.
•	Led adoptions of JAX-WS as web service communication layer for Ad Systems department by researching, testing, developing guidelines.
•	End to end development of various tools to support Popup Systems group using Swing UI and Tomcat.
•	Designed of Sales Planning, Reservations applications and various sales tools using Visual Basic, ADO and Sybase.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked at government contractors Statistic Inc and GRCI with Top Secret Clearance.   Responsible for system administration, development, integrations, fielding and testing.
•	Developed a real time system in VB6 for US Army using Windows API’s, Active X, ADO, SQL Server, Windows sub class and messages.
•	Designed prototype software for Division XXI experiment for the Army using C, DCE/RPC, embedded SQL, TCP/IP to send/receive, parse, filter and store messages.
•	Supported the fielding of GCCS-A software on location such South Korea and various US Army bases.
•	Automated installation process of Sun Solaris OS and GCCS-A software stack by using shell scripting and imaging tool.  
•	Built a client application to monitor and control main application server from remote client using TCP/IP Socket protocol.
